_comment: Camera registry for the two-camera Sony ILX-LR1 stereo rig captured
with Wild Sync. Loaded and validated by modules/camera_registry.py at
import time: a malformed entry stops the import with a message naming
it. Keys starting with '_' are comments; consumers ignore them.
cameras: one entry per physical camera, with the calibration
RealityScan may receive (modules/calibration_sidecars.py decides when).
The calibration record is calibration/ilx_lr1_stereo_dive_001.json;
tests/test_camera_registry.py asserts that both files agree.
families: Wild Sync filename families, searched in order
(case-insensitive); the first match wins.
rigs: the stereo pair, kept as data (see rigs._comment).
Flight-log prior accuracies used when no other value is given.
Position accuracy is the end-to-end per-image uncertainty, not the
sensor specification. Orientation accuracy stays wide until the
mount and the attitude convention are checked on a real run.
Tighter claimed position and orientation accuracies fragmented
solves on earlier datasets (docs/rs-reference/13 section 7.5).
Pitch accuracy is per mount (families[].mount.pitch_accuracy_deg).
One calibration group and one lens-distortion group per physical
camera. resolution is the calibration image size in pixels and
calibration_focal_mm the lens focal length the calibration was
solved at: 16 mm as stated for the calibration session
(2026-09-30); the calibration images carry no EXIF.
focal_length_35mm, principal_point_u and principal_point_v are the
calibration in RealityScan's normalised XMP form
(calibration_sidecars.intrinsics_to_xmp_values). They hold only for
images with the calibration's aspect ratio and focal length, which
modules/calibration_sidecars.py checks before writing them.
calibration_prior and lens_distortion_prior 'approximate': written
as an initial prior that alignment adjusts, never as a fixed one.

ilx_left._provenance: Checkerboard solve 2026-09-30 from Stereo_Calibration/dive_001 (pool, 2026-05-18): 60 of 61 detected boards used, reprojection RMS 1.15 px. Focal FIXED at the stated 16 mm (fx=fy=2016.8 px, assuming the 3000 px image height spans the 23.8 mm sensor height); a free-focal solve gave fx=1985+/-49 px at the same RMS. Principal point 1-sigma +/-14/15 px. UNVALIDATED as a RealityScan prior.
ilx_left._distortion_comment: OpenCV order k1, k2, p1, p2, k3; k3 and the tangential terms were held at 0 in the solve. modules/calibration_sidecars.py writes them in RealityScan's Brown slot order.

ilx_right._provenance: Checkerboard solve 2026-09-30 from Stereo_Calibration/dive_001 (pool, 2026-05-18): 59 of 59 detected boards used, reprojection RMS 1.40 px. Focal FIXED at the stated 16 mm (fx=fy=2016.8 px, assuming the 3000 px image height spans the 23.8 mm sensor height); a free-focal solve gave fx=1995+/-54 px at the same RMS. Principal point 1-sigma +/-19/20 px. UNVALIDATED as a RealityScan prior.
ilx_right._distortion_comment: OpenCV order k1, k2, p1, p2, k3; k3 and the tangential terms were held at 0 in the solve. modules/calibration_sidecars.py writes them in RealityScan's Brown slot order.

families._comment: Wild Sync node cam1 is the left camera (ilx_left) and node cam2 the right camera (ilx_right). The maintainer confirmed this assignment on 2026-10-05; no file in this repository or in Wild Sync records it. These two rows are the only place it is encoded (see rigs.ilx_lr1_stereo.node_assignment_confirmed). Patterns match every Wild Sync file of the camera (.jpg, .card.JPG, .ARW, .xmp). mount: down_tilt_deg is the camera's tilt below the vehicle's forward axis (90 = looking straight down); yaw_offset_deg is the direction of the image top relative to the heading; pitch_accuracy_deg is the accuracy claimed for the pitch prior; lever_arm_m is the [forward, right, down] offset in metres from the navigation reference, or null when not measured (zero offset is used and a notice is logged). None of these mount values is measured: both cameras are nominally downward-looking with the image top along the heading, and the pitch accuracy is the default 15 deg orientation accuracy.

_comment: RealityScan has no usable stereo-rig input: rig sidecars (xcr:Rig)
require a .rcrx rig file that no install provides
(docs/rs-reference/13 section 3.5). Nothing in this repository writes
rig XMP or turns these values into solver constraints; the baseline
and extrinsics are kept as data.

ilx_lr1_stereo._comment: Calibration record, solve quality and calibration image pairs: calibration/ilx_lr1_stereo_dive_001.json.
ilx_lr1_stereo._node_assignment_comment: true: the families' cam1 -> ilx_left, cam2 -> ilx_right assignment is confirmed. Set it to false if the cameras are ever swapped between nodes or housings. While it is false, calibration that depends on the eye (principal point, distortion) is never applied; each camera still gets its own calibration and distortion group.
ilx_lr1_stereo._stereo_baseline_comment: SUPPLIED, not measured here: 225.425 mm from docs/rs-reference/13 section 3.5, confirmed by the operator. The checkerboard square size is unknown, so the solve is in square units (|T|=19.38 squares) and this baseline sets the scale; implied square 11.63 mm.

extrinsics_left_to_right._convention: OpenCV: X_right = R * X_left + T, camera frames x right, y down, z forward, T in metres.
